purpose: Fast, repository-local inventory of implemented frontend routes, gateway routes, public API endpoints, test-only routes, and Agentic AI endpoint status.
updatePolicy: Update this catalog in the same change as any route or endpoint addition, modification, rename, move, or removal.
Describe the endpoint's purpose and usage; record historical rationale in an ADR or normal change documentation when needed.
Keep docs/contracts/ui-integration.json synchronized for every endpoint referenced by a registered web or mobile workflow.
Do not list generated bin/obj output, test fixtures, reserved architecture, or absent AI services as production endpoints.
Run .agents/scripts/validate_endpoint_catalog.py after source or catalog changes.

publicApiEndpoints.usage: Used by local stack health checks and operational diagnostics.

publicApiEndpoints.usage: Used by the mounted API Swagger UI and local contract inspection.

publicApiEndpoints.usage: Used by developers and contract tooling to inspect the public API, Auth and Coastal Operations contracts without accessing internal service hosts.

publicApiEndpoints.usage: Used for Auth contract inspection without exposing the Auth service host directly.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Creates a new user account and establishes the initial authentication result.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Creates accounts from the shared React and Flutter registration workflow and returns the first session through browser cookies or native credentials.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Authenticates credentials and returns the access and refresh session result.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Primary sign-in operation for the React and Flutter Auth workflow.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Refreshes an access token using an approved refresh token and can activate a previously signed-in browser account.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Keeps an existing client session alive and lets the React browser account switcher select one of its protected account-scoped cookie sessions without replacing other accounts.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Ends only the authenticated account's current-device session.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Signs out the active account from this device while leaving other accounts on the same browser and this account's sessions on other devices active.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Ends the authenticated account's session on the current device; an account cannot end a different account's session.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Provides a guarded account-specific current-device sign-out route for the authenticated account only.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Ends only the authenticated account's session on the current device; other signed-in accounts must sign out separately.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Used by the React and Flutter account menus to sign out the active account while keeping other saved accounts and sessions available; requests targeting a different account are forbidden.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Revokes all sessions for the authenticated account across devices after verifying the current password.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Available only from Login Sessions in the Profile workflows; password verification is required before any session is revoked.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Lists active sessions for the authenticated account.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Used by Profile in React Web and Flutter Mobile to review and end login sessions for the current account.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Revokes one selected authenticated session; the current session may be ended directly, while another device session requires current-password verification.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Supports Profile in React Web and Flutter Mobile with session-scoped end actions and server-verified password confirmation for remote devices.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Changes the authenticated user's password after validating the current credential.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Used by the Profile account-security section in React Web and Flutter Mobile.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Returns the current authenticated user's profile and authorization context.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Used by the React and Flutter Auth workflow to restore the signed-in account, by profile management to show server-owned details, and by the dashboard to personalize the account overview.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Updates editable profile data for the current authenticated user.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Updates the current user's editable full name from the shared React and Flutter profile-management workflow.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Deletes the current authenticated account, except accounts assigned a system role, which are prohibited from self-deletion.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Called after the user confirms the red account-deletion warning in Profile; a denied deletion names the system role or roles assigned to that account.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Reports Auth service and database readiness.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Used by the API gateway and Docker-stack health diagnostics.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Reports Coastal Operations PostgreSQL connectivity and migration readiness plus the latest status of optional Member 1–3 peer requests.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Used by the API gateway and Docker-stack readiness diagnostics; peer status is informational and does not gate readiness.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Reports Coastal Operations process liveness without probing optional dependencies.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Used by container and orchestrator liveness checks.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Reports Coastal Operations database connectivity and migration readiness plus the latest optional Member 1–3 dependency outcomes.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Used to determine whether the required PostgreSQL schema is ready; absent or unhealthy peer components do not make Coastal Operations unready.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Returns the Coastal Operations OpenAPI document through the public API gateway.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Loaded by the Coastal Operations entry in the shared Swagger UI at `/api/swagger`.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Creates a caller-owned Coastal Operations assessment draft without calling peer services or the disconnected pre-G07 AI seam.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Requires an Idempotency-Key. Returns DRAFT with NOT_CONNECTED AI status and no peer dependency results. Submit the draft separately to collect bounded Member 1–3 outcomes.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Updates a caller-owned assessment draft with optimistic version checking.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Only DRAFT assessments can be updated. The request supplies expectedVersion; each accepted change increments the version and creates an audit record.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Logically cancels a caller-owned assessment draft and retains its tombstone.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Requires expectedVersion and Idempotency-Key. Returns CANCELLED with actor/time fields and records an audit event; submitted or closed assessments cannot be deleted.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Submits a caller-owned assessment draft and records bounded Member 1–3 dependency outcomes.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Requires expectedVersion and Idempotency-Key. Peer calls have bounded timeouts/retries; dependency failure is recorded without failing the service. Before G07 the result remains SUBMITTED with AI status NOT_CONNECTED and no proposal.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Lists the caller's assessments or the authorized review queue with bounded cursor pagination.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: operations.assessment.read is scoped to the caller's own non-cancelled assessments, including drafts; operations.assessment.queue.read grants the submitted-work queue. Cancelled drafts are excluded by default and require includeCancelled=true for authorized audit readers.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Returns an in-scope assessment and its recorded reviewer decisions.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Assessment readers may inspect their own records, including their cancelled drafts; queue readers may inspect in-scope records. Evidence metadata is included only with operations.evidence.read.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Records an authorized approve, reject or request-revision decision against a validated proposal version.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Requires Idempotency-Key and expected target-state version. Returns a conflict without mutation when no pre-G07 proposal exists.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Reads a known Coastal Operations managed target's operational state and concurrency version.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: A missing baseline is initialized once from a current, validated provisional Member 1 availability response; this branch-local producer contract remains pending shared G00 acceptance.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Returns bounded, cursor-paginated operational state transitions for an authorized target.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: History is produced atomically with an approved target-state transition.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Lists authorized Coastal Operations alert records with lifecycle and target filters.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Non-managers see only currently active PUBLIC alerts within their validity period. Alert managers can inspect all visibility scopes; WITHDRAWN records are included only when explicitly requested.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Creates an unpublished, versioned operational alert draft.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Validates its time period, target identity and optional matching assessment; no external alert delivery is performed.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Updates a proposed alert draft using optimistic version checks.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Only PROPOSED drafts can be edited; active alert content must be replaced by a new proposal.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Publishes or resolves an alert through an authorized, idempotent lifecycle decision.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Requires Idempotency-Key and expected version. HIGH/CRITICAL publication requires a reviewer different from the drafter and linked assessment initiator.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Logically withdraws a caller-owned proposed alert draft with an audited tombstone.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Requires expectedVersion and Idempotency-Key. Only PROPOSED alerts can be withdrawn; the WITHDRAWN record and actor/time audit remain available to alert managers.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Validates and privately stores one assessment image, then returns versioned evidence metadata.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Accepts only static PNG image content up to 5 MiB for an owned DRAFT, SUBMITTED or REVISION_REQUESTED assessment; at most five immutable attachments are allowed per assessment, and each accepted upload increments the assessment version.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Returns privately stored PNG evidence after owner/reviewer scope and content integrity checks.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Returns no-store image content through the public API; callers receive no storage URL. Reviewers also need assessment queue access.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Lists permissions available to an authorized administration caller.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Supports authorization administration and permission discovery.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Returns one permission by identifier.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Supports authorization administration and permission detail views.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Lists roles for authorized administration callers.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Supports role administration and authorization inspection.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Returns one role by identifier.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Supports role detail and authorization administration screens.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Creates a role when the caller has both role-read and role-create permission.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Supports authorized role administration.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Updates role details when the caller has both role-read and role-update permission.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Supports authorized role administration.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Deletes an eligible non-system role when the caller has both role-read and role-delete permission.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Supports authorized role administration.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Replaces a non-system role’s permission set. Requires role read, role update and permission catalogue read together; system-role grants remain protected.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Role editors can grant or remove permissions from eligible non-system roles. The Auth service checks the caller’s current role assignments and invalidates affected user sessions.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Lists users for authorized administration callers.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Supports user administration and authorization inspection.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Returns one user by identifier.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Supports authorized user administration detail views.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Creates an account with user read and user create grants together; assigning initial roles also requires role read and any applicable system-role grant.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Supports authorized user administration.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Updates account details, active state or password with user read and user update grants together.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Supports authorized user administration.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Deletes an account with user read and user delete grants together, subject to protected system-role rules.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Supports authorized user administration; a protected account's assigned system role names are included in the deletion rejection.

publicApiEndpoints.description: Replaces an account’s roles with user read, user update and role read grants together; system-role changes require the dedicated grant, and an Admin cannot remove its own Admin system role.
publicApiEndpoints.usage: Authorized user editors can add or remove user roles; the service checks current caller grants, rejects Admin self-demotion before changing assignments or sessions, applies system-role constraints and invalidates sessions after accepted changes.
